rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an estimate, whether referring to the act of estimating or the resulting amount.

example.english: This is only a rough estimation and may not be accurate.
example.traditional: 呢個只係粗略估計，未必準確。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 cou1 loek6 gu2 gai3 mei6 bit1 zeon2 kok3

rows.note: Use this when the estimation involves a deliberate numerical or systematic calculation rather than a general guess.

example.english: The engineer used a computer to make an estimation of how much the project would cost.
example.traditional: 工程師用電腦估算呢個工程要幾多錢。
example.jyutping: gung1 cing4 si1 jung6 din6 nou5 gu2 syun3 ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 jiu3 gei2 do1 cin4

rows.note: Use this for the respect or favourable regard someone has for a person.

example.english: My estimation of that teacher is very high.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 zyun1 zung6 go2 wai6 lou5 si1
